---
title: "NSF grant awarded for microtransit equity research"
date: 2026-06-15
---

Delighted to share that our project, *Equitable Microtransit Design for Mid-Sized
Cities*, has been awarded funding by the National Science Foundation (Award #0000000).
The three-year project will study on-demand microtransit service design in partnership
with [Regional Transit Agency]. See the [Projects](../projects.qmd) page for details.
